qa.title: Q398 (Dec. 8, 2023)
qa.question: What's the deal with this card?
qa.answer: This card goes in your evolve deck, and is needed to race Umamusume followers. You do this by "serving" it to the follower and paying any play-point costs. Normally you can only have 3 copies of a card in any given deck, but you may put up to 10 copies of this card into your evolve deck.
